summary: Frontend-only verification of master-admin login + invite-only signup gating on Step Solar CRM. All 5 requested scenarios PASSED. Master admin (super@stepsolar.in) logs in and is redirected to /dashboard with correct profile (Master Admin, OWNER, Step Solar CRM). /signup (no invite) shows the 'Signup by invitation only' card with data-testid=signup-disabled-title and data-testid=signup-disabled-back-to-login; no signup form fields are rendered. /signup?invite=dummy-token-123 renders the full form (fullName + email + 2 password inputs + Create account button). /login (no invite) does NOT expose the 'Create account' link nor the 'Don’t have an account?' text. /login?invite=dummy-token-123 correctly exposes data-testid=login-create-account-link. Note: initial run had 5 spurious failures because the browser was still authenticated from the login test; middleware then bounced /signup and /login?invite to /dashboard. Re-running the signup/login-invite assertions in a fresh (unauthenticated) context passed all of them, which confirms the intended behaviour (authenticated users are already redirected away from auth routes — this is a plus, not a bug).

integration_issues.issue: Console error after login: '[PresenceHeartbeat] touch_presence failed: TypeError: Failed to fetch'. Non-blocking (dashboard still renders fine) but worth investigating — endpoint likely unreachable or CORS/mock issue.

action_items: Investigate the PresenceHeartbeat 'touch_presence failed: TypeError: Failed to fetch' console error on the dashboard (minor, non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: Guard for invite-only signup is implemented client-side only (page.tsx returns a blocked card when !inviteToken). A determined user could still POST to any signup API directly — verify server-side / Supabase policy also rejects self-signup without an invite. This wasn’t tested (backend-out-of-scope) but should be confirmed by the main agent.
test_credentials: super@stepsolar.in / Step.Solar@123 (master admin, owner of 'Step Solar CRM')
seed_data_creation: None. Master admin was pre-seeded by main agent via Supabase Admin API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master admin creds are in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Public signup is disabled by design — do not attempt to create users via /signup. For multi-user scenarios use Settings → Team → Invite inside the app. When testing /signup or /login?invite=... always start from a clean browser context (page.context.clear_cookies()) because middleware redirects authenticated users to /dashboard, which will otherwise cause false failures.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. The initial 5 failures during the first Playwright run were self-inflicted (single browser context, cookies persisted post-login, middleware redirected subsequent /signup and /login?invite navigations to /dashboard). Confirmed by re-running the same assertions after clearing cookies — all passed.
